answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance by tying identity to computational expenditure. As the dawn of decentralized AI emerges, agents must solve cryptographic puzzles that represent a sable, high-energy cost. An attacker creating fake identities faces a walnut-sized probability of success unless they control majority hash power. This economic barrier ensures that every participant incurs a verifiable, non-transferable expense, rendering the creation of infinite adversarial nodes prohibitively expensive.
